content: Public Solana RPC endpoints (api.devnet.solana.com) are rate-limited (~100-200 req/s per IP shared), no SLA, fine for light demo traffic but not resilient at scale. For a public-facing demo, a free-tier dedicated RPC provider (Helius, QuickNode, Alchemy) is recommended over the public endpoint to avoid shared rate-limit failures during traffic spikes (e.g. HN/LinkedIn spike).
